# YES Experiences Portugal

> Private, premium experiences in Portugal — Signature day tours, an Experience Studio that designs and reserves in minutes, bespoke multi-day journeys with a Travel Designer, private moments and celebrations, and corporate or private-group experiences across Portugal. Licensed Portuguese tour operator (RNAAT nº 31/2023), based in Sesimbra, Portugal. 4.9/5 across 1,000 guest reviews on major booking and review platforms.

## Facts

- Licensed Portuguese tour operator: RNAAT nº 31/2023.
- Rated 4.9/5 across 1,000 guest reviews on major booking and review platforms.
- Private experiences only — never shared groups.
- Pickup from anywhere in Portugal, not only Lisbon.
- Journeys of any length: one day to multi-week, starting anywhere in the country.
- Instant online confirmation on Signature experiences and Studio-designed days.
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the experience, with full refund.
- Contact: info@yesexperiencesportugal.com · WhatsApp available on the contact page.

## Signature Experiences

Private full-day experiences with live per-person pricing by group size and instant confirmation. Prices shown are the per-person "from" rate (largest group tier); smaller groups pay more per person.

- [Arrábida Private Wine Tour from Lisbon — All-Inclusive](/tours/arrabida-wine-allinclusive): 7–9h, from €135 per person. Two family wineries, Moscatel tastings, Livramento market, traditional lunch.
- [Arrábida & Sesimbra Private Tour with Coastal Boat Ride](/tours/arrabida-boat): 6–8h, from €135 per person. Coast, coves, boat trip and a fishing-town lunch in Sesimbra.
- [Lisbon Coastal Tour — Arrábida, Sesimbra & Beach Picnic](/tours/wild-beaches-picnic): 7h30, from €118 per person. Wild beaches and a private picnic on the sand.
- [Tile Painting Workshop, Wine Tasting & Sesimbra](/tours/tiles-workshop): 8–9h, from €135 per person. Hands-on azulejo painting, wine tasting and Sesimbra.
- [Azeitão Cheese-Making & Wine Private Tour](/tours/azeitao-cheese): 8–9h, from €101 per person. Make Azeitão cheese, taste wines, visit Setúbal.
- [Sintra & Cascais Private Tour — Hidden Gems & Wine Tasting](/tours/sintra-cascais): 8–10h, from €161 per person. Palaces, coast and a wine tasting.
- [Tróia & Comporta Private Tour — Ruins, Wine & Coast](/tours/troia-comporta): 8–9h, from €157 per person. Roman ruins, rice fields and Comporta's beaches.
- [Évora & Alentejo Wine Private Tour — Local Traditions](/tours/evora-alentejo): 9–11h, from €169 per person. Évora's monuments and Alentejo wine country.
- [Roman Heritage Wine Tour — Hidden Alentejo](/tours/roman-heritage-alentejo): 8–9h, from €254 per person. Roman sites and talha wine in the deep Alentejo.
- [Tomar & Coimbra Private Tour — Templars & Heritage](/tours/tomar-coimbra): 8–9h, from €152 per person. Templar castle and Portugal's oldest university city.
- [Fátima, Nazaré & Óbidos Private Tour — Spirit & Charm](/tours/fatima-nazare-obidos): 8–9h, from €135 per person. Sanctuary, giant-wave coast and a walled medieval town.
- [Southwest Vicentine Coast — Secret Paradise](/tours/southwest-vicentine-coast): 9–10h, from €203 per person. Cliffs, wild beaches and fishing villages on the Costa Vicentina.
